column1: Data refferent to each coastal target point (CTP) across the European coastline regarding the characterization of total water level (TWL) storms
RP50: TWL value associated to a 50-year return period event, in meters
RP100: TWL value associated to a 100-year return period event, in meters
Dur_hist: mean storm duration at each CTP, based on all identified individual storm events, in hours
Dur_RP50: 50-year return period storm duration for each CTP, in hours
Dur_RP100: 100-year return period storm duration for each CTP, in hours
ST_A_perc: percentage of storms within each CTP classified as storm type (ST) A
ST_B_perc: percentage of storms within each CTP classified as storm type (ST) B
ST_C_perc: percentage of storms within each CTP classified as storm type (ST) C
ST_D_perc: percentage of storms within each CTP classified as storm type (ST) D
